tests.reason: Untestable (no way): VS Code 1.147.0 on macOS offers no read of a terminal cell or its link. Verified src/vscode-dts/vscode.d.ts at tag 1.147.0: export interface Terminal still carries only name, processId, creationOptions, exitStatus, state, shellIntegration, sendText, show, hide and dispose; TerminalShellExecution.read() returns plain text only. The renderer's link layer needs a --remote-debugging-port launch, which is not a default-launch reader, and its hover tooltip needs a pointer the owned-host no-input rule forbids. OSC 8 has no query form, and the plain probe only reads the cursor, which cannot verify link metadata. This records the observation surface, not whether the app stores the link.
